old_caption: The video opens with a serene forest scene featuring a small pond surrounded by tall trees and lush greenery. The water is calm, reflecting the surrounding foliage and sky. In the foreground, various plants and fallen leaves are visible, adding texture to the scene. One individual dressed in dark clothing is seen walking slowly along the edge of the pond, moving from left to right across the frame. Another individual remains stationary near a tree. The camera remains mostly static with a slight drift, capturing the scene without panning. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, with the sounds of nature likely providing a soothing backdrop to the visual elements.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a serene forest scene featuring a small pond surrounded by tall trees and lush greenery. The water is calm, reflecting the surrounding foliage and sky. In the foreground, various plants and fallen leaves are visible, adding texture to the scene. Two individuals dressed in dark clothing are seen walking along the edge of the pond, moving from left to right across the frame. As they walk, their reflections shimmer on the water's surface. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the tranquil environment and the gentle movement of the people through the natural setting. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, with the sounds of nature likely providing a soothing backdrop to the visual elements.
caption: A flooded cypress wetland shows green ferns and reddish-brown cypress knees rising from dark shallow water beneath tall, bare trunks under an overcast sky. A cross-dissolve edit blends two camera views of the same scene: the early view holds opaque foreground ferns and several background figures, one bent at the left, another bent beside a tree, and one standing near it. As the dissolve progresses those figures fade and the ferns turn translucent, revealing a more open-water view where tree reflections and cypress knees dominate the surface. In this second view a single person stays crouched beside the central trunk. A figure in dark clothing then walks across the background from left to right, passing behind the central tree toward the right edge. The water carries continuously shifting reflections of the sky and trunks.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;

claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
